Amanda L: Heads-up  webinar next Wed 10am PT. Need social plan: pre-post, day-of, follow. Also a 6-tweet X thread teasing benchmark wins. Who can own copy + final asset polish?

Raj P: Ill take copy. CTA = RSVP (cal.link). Target: PLG engineers + infra/platform leads. A/B test: numbers-first vs benefit-first.

Jen M: Can reuse last benchmark chart if license ok. Need export sizes: X hero 1200x675, LinkedIn 1200x627, square 600x600, thread card 800x418.

Drew G: I can do hero + GIF highlight. Need final copy by Fri EOD. GIF idea: animate cost delta bar.

Amanda L: Timeline: copy -> Fri EOD, assets final -> Mon AM. Schedule pre-post Wed 8:15am PT, day-of 9:50am PT, follow 12:30pm PT. Engagement: replies +10m, +1h, +4h.

Raj P: Draft X thread (short):
1/ New webinar: benchmark + playbooks to cut inference cost without quality loss. Register: [cal.link]
2/ We tested 5 open models under production traffic.
3/ Result: prefix caching + smart batching cut inference cost ~40%.
4/ Demo rollout patterns for spikes.
5/ Live Q&A  bring infra questions.
6/ Sign up: [cal.link]?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_jun

Jen M: For LinkedIn soften jargon and add a one-line customer example.

Amanda L: Routing: signups -> Intercom. Tag: webinar_jun, source:social, channel:x|linkedin. MQL if company_size>50 + engaged.

SocialBot: @Amanda L scheduling template ready. Run: `/schedule channel=marketing time=2120116800 assets=webinar_jun_v1 copy=raj_v1 tags=webinar_jun,source:social` react :white_check_mark: to confirm.

Drew G: Mockups due Mon 09:00 PT.

Amanda L: Final copy deadline Fri 5pm PT. Raj, ping when v1 is ready so Jen/Drew can iterate.

Raj P: Will post v1 Fri ~3pm.
